title: Thom polynomials relative to prescribed maps around the boundary
summary: Thom polynomials are universal cohomological obstructions to the appearance of singularities of given types in differentiable maps. As an application, various invariants of immersions have been expressed in terms of singularities of their extension maps, known as singular Seifert surfaces. To place these results in a unified framework, we aim in this paper to establish a relative version of Thom polynomial theory. Our results consist of four parts.
